claims.sourceText: RAND Corporation publication page and PDF for DRU-1571
claims.text: RAND published 'UFOs: What To Do?' by George Kocher as draft DRU-1571, originally November 1968; the document examines UFO brightness, size and manoeuvres and discusses a recommended course of action.

claims.sourceText: RAND publication page and PDF, DRU-1571
claims.text: RAND published George Kocher's 'UFOs: What To Do?' as draft DRU-1571 in November 1968.

edges.label: Published Kocher's 'UFOs: What To Do?' as DRU-1571, November 1968
edges.note: Issued two months before the Condon Committee report told the public the subject was closed; RAND has never withdrawn it.
